description: Returns the hours of a date range to you: totals, the billable share, the breakdown by project and the hours per day. It shows nothing to the user: use it when you need the numbers for something else, such as comparing periods, a calculation, or a report you write. show_statistics is the tool that answers the user's question about their hours with a card. Covers up to one year (366 days) per call; for a longer period, call it once per year. The totals include the running timer's time so far when it matches the filters.

endDate.description: End date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD)

projectId.description: Filter statistics for a specific project

startDate.description: Start date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD)

teamId.description: Filter statistics for a specific team

name: statistics_get

runningTimer.description: The running timer, already included in the totals; absent when no timer runs or it does not match the filters

title: Get Statistics
